note: Cross-implementation interop: the harness pairs a server from one implementation with a client from the other and compares the resulting transcripts against the all-upstream pair. `server`/`client` name the implementation for each side ("node" = upstream, "go" = the port). The upstream/upstream run is the oracle; the other three combinations must reproduce BOTH its server transcript and its client transcript. The scripted exchange is deliberately restricted to what both clients can express: connect, emit with mixed argument types, emit with an ack, emit binary with a binary ack, receive a server push, answer a server-initiated ack, disconnect. Same normalisation as the behaviour group.
